title: Oak Ridge visit arranged by Howard Baker

tellings.quote: I went to go up to Oak Ridge and spend some time with them

plain: Harold Malmgren, a former advisor to US presidents, says that sometime in the 1970s or 1980s a political figure named Howard Baker arranged for him to visit Oak Ridge, a US government nuclear research site in Tennessee, where he spent time with the people working there. He tells it as part of his account of handling UFO-related material, which, if true, would tie that material to top-level government science.
